info.title: RR Teams API v1
info.description: Versioned contract for the Android APK and admin custom views (architecture §6). Errors: RFC 9457.

bearer.description: Keycloak access token of client proyekkas-mobile (realm drms). Requires header X-Device-Id of a registered active device.

displayName.description: DRMS 10/10 WA-14: label to greet/show the caller (never empty): users.name → employee name of the membership in a selected PT (lowest PT id first, then other memberships) → email local part → "Pengguna". `name` stays the stored account name.

roles.description: DEPRECATED (MC3, kept for mobile-v0.2.0): union of the roles over the SELECTED PTs. Use companies[].roles.

approvalInbox.description: ADR 0013/0021/0026: holds pk-owner (label "Direktur"), pk-principal (label "Owner"), pk-finance or pk-pm (Persetujuan PM) → show the approval inbox.

teamMonitor.description: Holds pk-pm → team list/dashboard (monitoring only, no decisions).

progressReportCreate.description: E4: holds pk-pm (team projects), pk-owner or pk-admin (all) → may create progress reports.

serviceReportCreate.description: FR1 (ADR 0020): field reports on for the PT (companies.fieldReportsEnabled) and holds pk-staff (assigned projects), pk-pm (team) or pk-owner → may create service reports on projects of kind kontrak_unit / aftersales.

unitTimesheetCreate.description: FR1: same rule → unit timesheets on projects of kind kontrak_unit.

aftersalesActivityCreate.description: FR1: same rule → aftersales activities on projects of kind aftersales.

dailyReportCreate.description: P3: same rule → Laporan harian on projects of kind konstruksi.

capabilities.description: DEPRECATED (MC3): derived from the top-level `roles` (union over the selected PTs). Use companies[].capabilities.

homeSite.description: ADR 0023: "Site penempatan" (kantor cabang) of the employee, null when none.

employee.description: DEPRECATED (MC3): employee of the PT `legacyCompanyId`. Use companies[].employee.

settings.description: DEPRECATED (MC3): per-PT values of `legacyCompanyId` + app-wide values. Use companies[].settings + appSettings.

companies.description: MC3: every active membership of the caller (active PTs), ascending id.

activeCompanyIds.description: MC3: effective selection of this request (ascending).

legacyCompanyId.description: MC3: PT of the deprecated single-PT fields = first selected membership (ascending id) with an employee, else the first selected one. One PT → that PT.

appSettings.description: MC3: app-wide settings (one APK for all PTs).

Role.description: pk-owner = "Direktur"; pk-principal = "Owner" (ADR 0026: the approval level above the Direktur). Effective roles: an Owner is also listed with pk-owner (same view and permissions as the Direktur); only the approval flow differs.

code.description: PT short code ({COMPANY} token of document numbers), e.g. DRMS.

timezone.description: IANA; this release: equals the server TZ for every PT (ADR 0016 §9).

selected.description: In the effective selection of THIS request (X-Company-Ids / cookie ∩ memberships; default all).

roles.description: Roles IN this PT (company_memberships), effective: an Owner (pk-principal) is listed with pk-owner too (ADR 0026).

employeeId.description: Employee record of the caller in this PT (ADR 0016 D1: one per PT).

ownRequestNoApproval.description: ADR 0024 / 0026: the caller is Owner (pk-principal) in this PT and the PT has an active rule "Pengajuan Owner" (Peran pemohon = Owner, no approval level) — the APK shows "Pengajuan Anda langsung ke antrian transfer Finance" on the request form. Since ADR 0026 a Direktur's own request is approved by the Owner (false for a Direktur). Hint only; the rule is chosen at submit.

fieldReportsEnabled.description: FR1 (ADR 0020): field reports per project kind switched on for this PT (default false).

settings.description: Per-PT settings the APK needs (feature flags are applied per item PT: sync FEATURE_DISABLED).

homeSite.description: ADR 0023: "Site penempatan" (kantor cabang) of the employee, null when none.

approvalInbox.description: ADR 0013/0021/0026: holds pk-owner (label "Direktur"), pk-principal (label "Owner"), pk-finance or pk-pm (Persetujuan PM) → show the approval inbox.

teamMonitor.description: Holds pk-pm → team list/dashboard (monitoring only, no decisions).

progressReportCreate.description: E4: holds pk-pm (team projects), pk-owner or pk-admin (all) → may create progress reports.

serviceReportCreate.description: FR1 (ADR 0020): field reports on for the PT (companies.fieldReportsEnabled) and holds pk-staff (assigned projects), pk-pm (team) or pk-owner → may create service reports on projects of kind kontrak_unit / aftersales.

unitTimesheetCreate.description: FR1: same rule → unit timesheets on projects of kind kontrak_unit.

aftersalesActivityCreate.description: FR1: same rule → aftersales activities on projects of kind aftersales.

dailyReportCreate.description: P3: same rule → Laporan harian on projects of kind konstruksi.

Capabilities.description: UI hints for the APK (E1); the server guards stay authoritative.

currentVersion.description: Version of the notice this server serves (GET /privacy-notice).

ackVersion.description: Version the caller acknowledged; null = never. Ask again when < currentVersion.

ackAt.description: When it was acknowledged (UTC ISO-8601, server clock); null = never.

PrivacyStatus.description: ADR 0018: the APK blocks attendance until ackVersion ≥ currentVersion; the web admin shows an interstitial.

code.description: Machine-readable reason. 401 DEVICE_REVOKED = the token is valid but X-Device-Id was revoked/marked lost: the APK ends the session without a refresh. 403 PRIVACY_ACK_REQUIRED = attendance capture (selfie upload) while company-settings.minAppVersion ≥ 0.3.3 and the caller has not acknowledged the current privacy notice (ADR 0018): show the notice, POST /me/privacy-ack, then capture again.

version.description: Integer of the notice's "Versi" line; acknowledgements compare against it.

html.description: Safe HTML of the notice: escaped text, attribute-less tags only (h1–h4, p, ul/ol/li, table, strong, em, code, hr). No links, images or scripts.

markdown.description: Source markdown (docs/proyekkas/legal/pemberitahuan-privasi.md, bundled at build time).

ackAt.description: UTC ISO-8601 (DB clock). Unchanged when the version was already acknowledged.

version.description: Version the user read; must equal the current version (else 409 PRIVACY_VERSION_MISMATCH).
Hash of this PT's items of the requested types in this answer (same types → same version = nothing changed).

companies.description: MC3: PTs covered by this answer (selection narrowed by ?company=), ascending id.

sharedVersion.description: MC3: hash of the shared masters in this answer.

Masters.description: Response header ETag (weak); send it back as If-None-Match → 304 without a body when nothing changed. Cache per PT: request with X-Company-Ids (or ?company=) = one PT.

MasterItem.description: Whitelisted fields per type (id, updatedAt, active, …) plus MC3 `company` (PT id; null for shared masters) and `shared` (true for banks, uoms, holidays). ADR 0024: `employees` items carry `direktur` (bool: the account holds Direktur — or, ADR 0026, Owner — in that PT; not offered as requester to others).

integrityRisk.description: Any integrity signal set at the last check (rooted, emulator, mock location).

deviceId.description: Install id generated by the APK (UUID); must equal X-Device-Id.

fcmToken.description: FCM token (ADR 0011); null clears it, omitted keeps it. Push is not enabled yet (GET /app/config features.pushEnabled).

DeviceIntegrity.description: Best-effort device signals (ADR 0010 decision 10), sent at register. Recorded and audited, never blocking; omitted keeps the stored values. mockLocation null = not measured (needs a GPS fix, F5).

jobId.description: payload_jobs id of the sendEmail job (sent by the worker)

companyId.description: MC3: PT of the request (label: GET /me companies[]).

RequestType.description: advance = Pengajuan Baru (label until 2026-10: Uang Muka), reimburse = Reimburse

companyId.description: MC3: PT of the request (label: GET /me companies[]).

accountNo.description: Masked (last 4) unless own request or Finance/Owner/Admin.

unitPriceDisplay.description: unitPrice, else total ÷ qty (display only; lines saved before D3).

total.description: Server-computed qty × unitPrice (D3). 0 = incomplete line (no unit price yet).

receiptMismatch.description: receiptAmount set and ≠ total (live; the stored Finance flag is flags[] kind receipt_amount_mismatch).

rapItem.description: D4: RAP item of the line (name = the item's uraian).

rapOverBudget.description: D4: live "Melebihi RAP" (approved realisation of the item + this request > planned). Always false for callers without a RAP price role (Staff).

acknowledgeBy.description: ADR 0021: scope_manager with decisionRoles = "Persetujuan PM" by the PM project (acknowledgerUserId), then the Direktur level; scope_manager without decisionRoles = pre-E1 snapshot (PM "Diketahui").

acknowledgeRole.description: ADR 0013: pk-owner (label "Direktur") when "Diketahui" is the Direktur approval.

decisionRoles.description: ADR 0013: roles that may acknowledge/approve/reject ([pk-owner, pk-finance]); empty = pre-E1 snapshot (old guards).

skipped.description: ADR 0013 G1-2: positions skipped at submit because their only holders are requester/creator — show "(tidak berlaku — pemohon)".

selfApproval.description: G1 exception of the snapshot. ADR 0026 (owner 2026-10-13): principal_no_approval = the Owner's OWN request under the zero-step rule "Pengajuan Owner" — no approval step, straight to the Finance transfer queue; show the step "Persetujuan" (skipped) with the note "Tanpa persetujuan — pengajuan Owner (kebijakan PT)". Since ADR 0026 a Direktur's own request is approved by the Owner (direktur_no_approval stays on older requests). ADR 0024 (owner 2026-10-11): direktur_no_approval = a Direktur's OWN request under a zero-step rule — no approval step at all, straight to the Finance transfer queue; show the step "Persetujuan" (skipped) with the note "Tanpa persetujuan — pengajuan Direktur (kebijakan PT)" and status "Tanpa persetujuan (Antri Transfer)". Legacy ADR 0021 (no longer set for new requests): a Direktur's request filed by the PM project (PM approves, then a Direktur). direktur_via_pm = another Direktur decides the Direktur step; direktur_via_pm_self = the requester Direktur may approve (only Direktur of the PT, owner 2026-10-11). Show the note "Pengajuan Direktur — diajukan oleh PM …".

kind.description: receipt_amount_mismatch = "Selisih nota" (D3); rap_over_budget = "Melebihi RAP" (D4, warning, not blocking; only for Direktur/Admin/Finance/PM).

transferAt.description: Item 11: date + time of the proof (UTC ISO); null = recorded without a time.

costCenter.description: D2: cost center chosen by Finance (null on transfers recorded before DRMS 10/10).

budget.description: US-26 preview (committed % before → after); cost centers: "none" (Q-24). Owner 2026-10-11: "none" + nulls for callers without a money role in the PT (Staff) — the % with the total would reveal the RAB.

allowedActions.description: UI hint; the server re-checks every action.

approvedAt.description: Item 11: final approval time (server) of the current cycle; start of the transfer SLA.

rev.description: Content revision (sync `base_rev` for offline edits of a draft, ADR 0010).

timeline.description: Status path of the request type with done / current / todo marks (US-05).

nextActor.description: "Giliran": who is expected to act next and what (display text, Bahasa Indonesia); null when finished.

photos.description: Point 13: LPJ photo ids (media-receipts; file: GET /api/v1/media/receipts/{id}/file).

receiptsTotal.description: Σ active receipts (pending + valid); refreshed at every LPJ submit and — QA-09 — after every receipt add / edit / remove / valid / reject while the LPJ is open.

difference.description: transferred − receipts (verified after verification): > 0 refund, < 0 shortfall.

reversalCount.description: E9: how often the settlement was reversed (void of the refund KM / shortfall transfer).

limit.description: approved + ⌊approved × tolerance / 100⌋: highest total transfer without re-approval.

totalAfter.description: Transferred total after paying the shortfall.

settleAllowed.description: LPJ verified: may the shortfall be paid now (within tolerance or approved)? null when not verified.

noApproval.description: ADR 0024 / 0026: the shortfall of a Direktur's (older requests) or the Owner's own request was approved without a decision (kebijakan PT; audited; statusLabel names which).

amount.description: Total transfer the (last) re-approval is about.

allowedActions.description: UI hint for the caller; the server re-checks.

shortfallApproval.description: QA-06 / ADR 0019 (Finance/Direktur of the PT only; null otherwise or without a shortfall): shortfall vs approved + tolerance and its re-approval.

Settlement.description: T5 LPJ (Pengajuan Baru only; null before "Nota Lengkap").

company.description: MC4: explicit PT (companies id) of the new record. Must be one of your PTs where you hold the role this create needs (else 403 COMPANY_NOT_ALLOWED) and the PT of the referenced project / cost center / cash account (else 400 COMPANY_MISMATCH; a reference in a PT you are not mapped to is answered like a missing one). Omitted = derived from the references, else your only selected PT (unchanged behaviour of APK 0.2.x / 0.3.0).

projectId.description: D2 (DRMS 10/10): required to submit (no non-project requests).

costCenterId.description: D2: IGNORED since DRMS 10/10 (Finance sets the cost center at the transfer). Still accepted so older apps keep working.

urgencyLevelId.description: urgency-levels id of the request PT ("Tingkat urgensi", owner decision 2026-10-09).

periodFrom.description: Ignored since 2026-10-09: "Periode kegiatan" was replaced by the urgency level. Still accepted so older apps keep working.

periodTo.description: Ignored since 2026-10-09: "Periode kegiatan" was replaced by the urgency level. Still accepted so older apps keep working.

requesterIds.description: "Diajukan Oleh" in order (default: the caller's employee).

bankAccountId.description: employee-bank-accounts id of one of the requesters (Q-11).

clientUuid.description: APK offline id; a retry with the same value returns the existing draft.

id.description: Existing line id (keep to update a line in place; omit for new lines).

qty.description: Quantity (≤ 3 decimals); empty = 1. A unit (uomId) is required when qty is set.

unitPrice.description: D3 (DRMS 10/10): required to submit. The line total is computed by the server: total = qty × unitPrice (qty empty = 1), rounded to whole Rupiah.

total.description: READ-ONLY since D3: ignored when unitPrice is sent (the server computes qty × unitPrice). Compatibility for old clients that send only `total`: unitPrice = total ÷ qty when that is a whole Rupiah amount, else the line stays incomplete (cannot be submitted).

receiptAmount.description: D3 "Nominal sesuai nota" (optional). When set and ≠ total, the request carries the awareness flag `receipt_amount_mismatch` ("Selisih nota") for Finance; amounts stay based on total.

rapItemId.description: D4 (DRMS 10/10): RAP item of the request project (GET /projects/{id}/rap items[].id). Required on every line to submit when the project has a RAP; a konstruksi project without RAP cannot submit. Omitted = the line (same id) keeps its stored item; null clears it.

projectId.description: D2 (DRMS 10/10): required to submit (no non-project requests).

costCenterId.description: D2: IGNORED since DRMS 10/10 (Finance sets the cost center at the transfer). Still accepted so older apps keep working.

urgencyLevelId.description: urgency-levels id of the request PT ("Tingkat urgensi", owner decision 2026-10-09).

periodFrom.description: Ignored since 2026-10-09: "Periode kegiatan" was replaced by the urgency level. Still accepted so older apps keep working.

periodTo.description: Ignored since 2026-10-09: "Periode kegiatan" was replaced by the urgency level. Still accepted so older apps keep working.

requesterIds.description: "Diajukan Oleh" in order (default: the caller's employee).

bankAccountId.description: employee-bank-accounts id of one of the requesters (Q-11).

ExpenseRequestUpdate.description: Draft only. Omitted fields stay unchanged; `lines` replaces all lines.

docType.description: expense_request, or a satellite: receipt, transfer, settlement, cash_entry.

signatureMediaId.description: media-signatures id captured on screen (own upload); default = profile signature.

imageId.description: media-receipts id uploaded by the caller (POST /media/receipts).

transferDate.description: Legacy: date only (time unknown). With transferAt it must equal the date of transferAt in the PT zone.

transferAt.description: Item 11: date + time of the bank transfer proof. ISO 8601 with offset, or without offset = wall clock in the PT time zone. Not in the future; its date (PT zone) becomes transferDate (period lock). Omitted = old client, transfer time unknown.

costCenterId.description: D2 (DRMS 10/10): cost center of the money, chosen by Finance — active, of the request PT. Omitted/null → the project default (GET /transfer-queue costCenter), else 400 (path costCenterId).

amount.description: Optional echo; must equal the approved amount (Finance cannot change it, G3).

confirmOverdraft.description: QA-04: confirm that this cash-out may make the cash account balance negative (else 409 CASH_OVERDRAFT_CONFIRM_REQUIRED with balance/after); audited overdraft_confirmed.

confirmUnverifiedAccount.description: QA-17: confirm a transfer to a bank account with verificationStatus ≠ verified (else 409 BANK_ACCOUNT_UNVERIFIED_CONFIRM_REQUIRED); audited bank_unverified_confirmed.

companyId.description: MC3: PT of the request (label: GET /me companies[]).

costCenter.description: D2: suggested cost center of the transfer (the project default, else a legacy request's own); null = Finance must pick one.

bankVerification.description: QA-17: unverified → the transfer needs confirmUnverifiedAccount.

sla.description: Item 11: age since the final approval vs the PT transfer SLA.

noApproval.description: ADR 0024: a Direktur's own request without any approval (kebijakan PT) — show the badge "Tanpa persetujuan (Direktur)"; Finance's transfer checks are the only check. ADR 0026: also the Owner's own request (see noApprovalBy).

noApprovalBy.description: ADR 0026: whose own request went without approval — "owner" (rule "Pengajuan Owner") or "direktur" (ADR 0024, older requests); null when noApproval is false. Badge "Tanpa persetujuan (Owner|Direktur)".

proofId.description: QA-31: current proof (media-attachments id; GET /media/attachments/{id}/file); PATCH proofId adds or replaces it.

companyId.description: MC3: PT of the entry.

company.description: MC4: explicit PT (companies id) of the new record. Must be one of your PTs where you hold the role this create needs (else 403 COMPANY_NOT_ALLOWED) and the PT of the referenced project / cost center / cash account (else 400 COMPANY_MISMATCH; a reference in a PT you are not mapped to is answered like a missing one). Omitted = derived from the references, else your only selected PT (unchanged behaviour of APK 0.2.x / 0.3.0).

confirmOverdraft.description: QA-04: confirm that this cash-out may make the cash account balance negative (else 409 CASH_OVERDRAFT_CONFIRM_REQUIRED with balance/after); audited overdraft_confirmed.

proofId.description: QA-31 (ADR 0005 §5): add or replace the proof (media-attachments id uploaded by the caller); null removes it.

CashEntryUpdate.description: Manual entries of an open period only; amount/date/account changes = void + new entry.

siteId.description: ADR 0023 (Q-S7): site flag of the account (petty cash of a branch), null = none.

active.description: Inactive accounts keep their balance here but cannot take new postings (transfer form pickers hide them).

employee.description: Employee of THIS PT (null = unlink; omitted = unchanged).

usageNotes.description: Required at the first submit; kept on resubmit when omitted.

photos.description: Point 13: LPJ photos — media-receipts ids (POST /api/v1/media/receipts, images only), max 10. Replaces the whole set.
Point 13: LPJ photos — media-receipts ids (POST /api/v1/media/receipts, images only), max 10. Replaces the whole set.

LpjPhotosBody.description: Point 13: save the LPJ photo set while the LPJ is editable (Draft / Revisi) — requester only.

date.description: KM date (refund) or transfer date (shortfall); default today.

proofMediaId.description: Shortfall: media-transfer-proofs id (required). Refund: media-attachments id (optional).

amount.description: Optional echo; must equal the server-computed |difference|.

confirmOverdraft.description: QA-04: confirm that this cash-out may make the cash account balance negative (else 409 CASH_OVERDRAFT_CONFIRM_REQUIRED with balance/after); audited overdraft_confirmed.

confirmUnverifiedAccount.description: QA-17: confirm a transfer to a bank account with verificationStatus ≠ verified (else 409 BANK_ACCOUNT_UNVERIFIED_CONFIRM_REQUIRED); audited bank_unverified_confirmed.

voided.description: Documents voided by the reversal (also in the audit log).

budgetWarnPct.description: Display default = the caller's only / lowest selected PT (MC4). Each item carries its own PT's threshold (items[].budget.warnPct).

scope.description: Project or cost center code + name.

stepLabel.description: ADR 0021: "Persetujuan PM" | "Persetujuan Direktur"; ADR 0013: "Persetujuan Direktur (Diketahui)" | "Approval level n" (legacy PM step: "Diketahui Oleh").

decisionFlow.description: ADR 0013/0021 decision flow (acknowledge = an approval, button "Setujui"); false = pre-E1 snapshot.

decisionBy.description: ADR 0021: who decides this step (APK decision sheet texts): pm = PM project, direktur, owner (ADR 0026: the Owner level above the Direktur), finance, other (named user / legacy).

finalStep.description: ADR 0021: approving this step makes the request "Disetujui" (Finance then transfers / verifies receipts).

selfApproval.description: ADR 0021 narrow G1 exception (a Direktur's request filed by the PM project; _self = the requester Direktur is the PT's only Direktur). Legacy since ADR 0024 (a request without approval never reaches the inbox).

warnPct.description: MC2: budgetWarnPct of the request's PT (overWarn = pctAfter > warnPct).

receiptMismatch.description: D3: lines with "Selisih nota" (receipt_amount_mismatch, open or reviewed).

companyId.description: MC3: PT of the document the notification is about (null = app-wide).

minSupportedVersion.description: Below this every authenticated call answers 426.

downloadUrl.description: APK download page (side-load); null = not published yet ("hubungi admin").

releaseNotes.description: Plain-text "Yang baru di versi …" bullets (Indonesian, ≤ 15 × ≤ 300 chars) of latestVersion, from the /unduh release manifest; omitted when the published APK is not latestVersion or has no notes.

timezone.description: Display timezone (IANA) — the server timezone every PT uses (ADR 0016 §9).

pushEnabled.description: false until FCM is configured (ADR 0011) — poll GET /notifications instead.

syncExpenseDrafts.description: MC4: true when at least one active PT allows it (per-PT value: GET /me companies[].settings.syncExpenseDraftsEnabled).

syncAttendance.description: MC4: true when at least one active PT allows it (per-PT value: GET /me companies[].settings.syncAttendanceEnabled).

syncProgressReports.description: MC4: true when at least one active PT allows it (per-PT value: GET /me companies[].settings.syncProgressReportsEnabled).

features.description: Public, unauthenticated hints (no PT is known before login). With several PTs each flag is the OR over the active PTs; the server still enforces the flag of the item's PT on every sync item (FEATURE_DISABLED). Clients that know the user read GET /me companies[].settings instead.

status.description: applied | duplicate (replay; original result below) | rejected (business rule, never retry) | conflict (stale base_rev, server wins, see server_copy) | deferred (retry later) | unsupported (item type not enabled on this server yet — keep it queued, do not count as an attempt; see GET /app/config features).

original_status.description: For duplicate: the status of the first processing.

server_id.description: Server id (numeric, as string) of the expense request / attendance / progress report.

received_at.description: Authoritative server time of (first) processing, UTC.

flags.description: OFFLINE, CLOCK_SKEW, CLIENT_TOTAL_MISMATCH, ALREADY_CANCELLED, DEVICE_TIME_ONLY; FR1 also BACKDATED, HM_GAP, BREAKDOWN_SUGGEST_SERVICE; P3 also MELEBIHI_RAP, POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE.

code.description: VALIDATION, NOT_EDITABLE, STALE_REV (conflict), NOT_FOUND, FORBIDDEN, MEDIA_MISSING, CLIENT_UUID_CONFLICT, COMPANY_NOT_ALLOWED (MC3: company_id is not an active membership of the caller), COMPANY_MISMATCH (MC3: the PT derived from the item references ≠ company_id — or ≠ the only PT of a caller without company_id; only for a PT the caller is mapped to — a reference in another PT is answered like a missing one, QA-MC4-14), FEATURE_DISABLED, DEPENDENCY_FAILED, DEPENDENCY_PENDING, STATE_CONFLICT, INTEGRITY, UNSUPPORTED, INTERNAL; attendance: MOCK_LOCATION, OUTSIDE_GEOFENCE, NOT_ASSIGNED, NO_GEOFENCE, ALREADY_CHECKED_IN, NO_CHECK_IN, ALREADY_CHECKED_OUT (on_behalf also FORBIDDEN: not a PM / not a team location / own attendance), PRIVACY_ACK_REQUIRED (ADR 0018: while the app setting minAppVersion ≥ 0.3.3, the caller — for on_behalf the PM — has not acknowledged the current privacy notice; final, never retry: show the notice, POST /me/privacy-ack, record again); progress reports: WEIGHTS_INCOMPLETE, PROGRESS_DECREASED, PHOTO_LIMIT, MEDIA_IN_USE; FR1 field reports: FEATURE_DISABLED, WRONG_PROJECT_KIND, HM_DECREASED, NOT_IN_CONTRACT, DUPLICATE_DATE, PO_CLOSED, PHOTO_LIMIT, MEDIA_IN_USE; P3 daily reports: DAILY_EXISTS, OVER_RAP_NOTE_REQUIRED.

company_id.description: MC3: PT the item was processed under (company_id, or the only PT of a legacy item); null when it was not an allowed PT.

SyncDraftCopy.description: Server version of the draft (server wins on conflict).

SyncProgressReportCopy.description: Server version of a progress report (server wins on conflict).

SyncServiceReportCopy.description: Server version of a service report (server wins on conflict).

SyncUnitTimesheetCopy.description: Server version of a unit timesheet (server wins on conflict).

SyncAftersalesActivityCopy.description: Server version of an aftersales activity (server wins on conflict; the value is not echoed).

SyncDailyReportCopy.description: Server version of a daily report (server wins on conflict); work / materials = current ledger sums.

device_id.description: Must equal the X-Device-Id of the registered device.

SyncBatch.description: ≤ 50 items and ≤ 262144 bytes JSON per batch (ADR 0010 decision 14).

device_time.description: Device wall clock at send time (with offset). Comparison only.

elapsed_ms.description: Android monotonic time since boot at send time.

last_server_time.description: server_time of the last successful online call on this boot.

client_uuid.description: Idempotency key of this queue item (UUIDv7). Replays return `duplicate` with the stored result.

company_id.description: MC3: PT of this item (an active membership of the caller). The item is processed under this PT whatever X-Company-Ids says; the PT derived from its references must match (else COMPANY_MISMATCH). Omitted (released APK ≤ 0.2.x) → the caller's only PT; a caller with several PTs gets 409 COMPANY_REQUIRED for the whole batch.

offline.description: true = created while offline (stored as a comparison flag).

device_time.description: Device wall clock when the user acted. Comparison only; the server time is authoritative.
